results.q: How much does the Starter plan cost?
results.a: The Starter plan costs 1,999 rupees per month and includes up to 3 users and call recording for 30 days.

results.q: What is the price of the Business plan and how many users does it include?
results.a: The Business plan costs 4,999 rupees per month and includes up to 10 users, the AI phone assistant, call tracking for agent mobile phones, and transcripts with AI summaries.

results.q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
results.a: Yes, there is a discount if you pay yearly. The Starter plan costs 1,999 rupees per month, and paying yearly would be 19,992 rupees per year.

results.q: What do I get with the Enterprise plan?
results.a: The Enterprise plan includes all the features of the Starter plan, plus single sign-on, a dedicated onboarding manager, custom data retention, and priority support.

results.q: How long do you keep my call recordings?
results.a: We keep your call recordings for 180 days by default, and transcripts are kept for one year.

results.q: And how long are transcripts kept?
results.a: Transcripts are kept for one year.
Your call recordings are stored in India in encrypted storage.

results.q: How often do calls from the agent app sync?
results.a: Calls from the agent app sync every two minutes and also immediately when a call ends.

results.q: Why are some calls on Android not recorded?
results.a: On Android 10 and newer, calls are recorded only if the phone's own dialer records them. This is because Android blocks most third-party recording apps.

results.q: What happens to a cloned voice if the person withdraws consent?
results.a: If a person withdraws consent for a cloned voice, the cloned voice is deleted within 24 hours.

results.q: बिज़नेस प्लान की कीमत क्या है?
results.a: बिज़नेस प्लान की कीमत 4,999 रुपये प्रति माह है, और इसमें 10 उपयोगकर्ताओं की सुविधा है, कॉल ट्रैकिंग एजेंट मोबाइल फ़ोन के लिए, और एआई सारांशों के साथ ट्रांसक्रिप्ट शामिल हैं।

results.q: रिकॉर्डिंग कितने दिन तक रखी जाती है?
results.a: कॉल रिकॉर्डिंग 30 दिन तक सेव रहती है।

results.q: स्टार्टर प्लान में कितने यूज़र मिलते हैं?
results.a: स्टार्टर प्लान में 3 यूज़र मिलते हैं।

results.q: मेरा डेटा कहाँ स्टोर होता है?
results.a: आपका डेटा हमारे सिस्टम में स्टोर होता है और हमारी टीम आपकी सुरक्षा और गोपनीयता का ध्यान रखती है।
